description: This file implements core functions for the SLAP Object Mapper, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal. It defines functions to manage the lifecycle of the SlapOmo object and interacts with related components such as object brokers.

classes.name: SLAP_OBJ_MAPPER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the SLAP Object Mapper, containing properties and function pointers for object lifecycle management.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapOmoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new SLAP Object Mapper instance, setting up function pointers and member variables.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOmoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the SLAP Object Mapper instance, including its associated object broker.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOmoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Ensures required object brokers are created and enrolled for the object mapper.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOmoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting default property values and function pointers.
